blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte will have to remain in detention at The Hague ahead of his trial after the Trial Chamber (TC) III of the International Criminal Court (ICC) found that the chances of him evading the proceedings and meddling with witnesses have increased. And even with his supposed cognitive issues, the chamber did not impose new measures for his continued detention at the Schveningen prison complex. The TC III, in a five-page second decision on Duterte’s detention released on Wednesday night, said that the turnover of the names of witnesses and a huge pile of evidence, as […]...
